rows.name: In-game residual memory
rows.expect: Balls in one game share a distance miss (wind, air, ball; split-half r +0.30); expect a small distance gain, larger near the wall. Needs exp_features_h12.parquet from round3.py memory.

rows.name: Batter residual memory
rows.expect: Batters carry a persistent distance miss (split-half r +0.42 to +0.50 on the test period, spread about 3 ft); expect a distance gain near the size of the contact-point gain (about 0.1 to 0.2 ft), plus a small near-wall gain. Residual-based, unlike the raw-average history groups that failed.

rows.name: Pitcher residual memory
rows.expect: Weaker than batters (split-half r +0.15 to +0.25); expect little. Likely kill.

rows.name: League drift memory
rows.expect: The model's near-wall home run rate is off by league-wide amounts that move by month (-3.0 points June 2025, +2.9 June 2026). A shrunk mean of the previous 30 days of home-run misses and 14 days of distance misses should absorb ball and season drift; expect a small Brier gain.

rows.name: Park by geometry, not team
rows.expect: Team code does not identify a park (the Athletics moved to Sutter Health Park in 2025 and the model still reads Oakland). Dropping it and using fence distances, elevation, roof and turf should fix new-park and fence-change errors; expect a gain at the Athletics, Detroit and similar parks, possibly a loss at parks with idiosyncratic effects the geometry misses.
